title: AccountingHub AR and aging group the invoice under the payer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a test organization whose invoices go to AccountingHub, and sign in to its AccountingHub company in a second tab.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, which owes nothing else.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today for $210.00, unpaid, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. In AccountingHub, open the AR aging for today.
  2. Find customer B's row.
  3. Find customer A's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The AR aging opens.

Step 2:

  • Customer B's row shows $210.00 owed for work order 1's invoice in the current bucket, and customer B's balance is $210.00.

Step 3:

  • Customer A has no row, or a row with $0.00 for this invoice.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12320 (Story 18, AccountingHub)

  • S18-R3: “AccountingHub AR, aging and balances therefore group by the Bill To.”
  • Key Decisions: “AccountingHub receives the invoice under the Bill To, as QuickBooks does. The invoice, its payments, deposits and credits sit on one customer, and no AccountingHub change is needed.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
